title: Guest saw no UFO trace among Stony Brook physicists
place_text: Stony Brook University, Yang Institute for Theoretical Physics

tellings.quote: interacted heavily with basically all of the leading professors of theoretical physics at Stonybrook at the time, 2004 to 2008 in the Yang Institute for Theoretical Physics and the math department. plain: From 2004 to 2008 a student at Stony Brook University in New York talked with nearly all its leading theoretical physicists and mathematicians and never saw "any hint or trace" of interest in UFOs. That student, the physicist Maaneli Derakhshani, says so from his own time there, at the university's physics institute and as president of the math club, and he mentions the mathematician Jim Simons. He tells it to push back on the idea that scientists there were tied to secret UFO work.
